exposure: IAP for Group B Streptococcus prophylaxis
IAP for elective or emergency caesarean section
cohort: 198 healthy term infants from the Canadian Healthy Infant Longitudinal Development (CHILD) Study
finding: Intrapartum antibiotic use, both in cesarean and vaginal deliveries, was associated with infant gut microbiota dysbiosis, with some changes persisting to 12 months, particularly among infants delivered by emergency CS and those who were not breastfed.
mod_finding: Intrapartum antibiotics use, in both caesarean and vaginal deliveries, is associated with infant gut microbiota dysbiosis.
